colors._note: #EA0A2A sampled directly from the claw marks in logo-dark.png (1,369 opaque pixels — the dominant non-black colour in the mark). #AD1B1E is the darker brick red the current site uses on buttons. The claw red is the brand's real signature and the aggressive direction the operator asked for, so it leads; #1C1B1A is the wordmark black.

claw.description: Four parallel diagonal slash marks in #EA0A2A, raked roughly 20-25deg from vertical, tapering at both ends, slicing across/behind the WOLFPACK wordmark. The single most recognisable element of the identity.

services.title: Roofing
services.short_description: Repair, replacement, installation and inspection for asphalt, metal, tile and flat roofs across Orlando.
services.long_description: Your roof is not just weather cover in Central Florida - it controls your interior climate, keeps pests out, and carries a real part of the structural load. Wolfpack Construction is licensed and insured for every category of residential and commercial roofing, from a single-slope leak repair to a full tear-off and rebuild in asphalt, metal, tile or flat systems.

services.title: Residential Construction
services.short_description: Custom homes, additions, and whole-home upgrades built by a family-owned Orlando general contractor.
services.long_description: Whether you are building a custom home for a growing family or reworking an existing property to fit how you actually live, Wolfpack handles the full residential scope - framing, drywall, flooring, granite, windows, painting, gutters and solar - under one certified general contractor.

services.title: Commercial Construction
services.short_description: Design-build, construction management and build-outs for Orlando businesses, permits included.
services.long_description: From ground-up builds to expanding an operating business, Wolfpack manages commercial projects start to finish - including City of Orlando and Orange County permitting and code compliance. Longstanding local roots mean realistic schedules and less disruption to the business next door.

services.title: Remodeling & Additions
services.short_description: Kitchen, bathroom and whole-home remodels plus room additions, on schedule and on budget.
services.long_description: Kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, granite, build-outs and full room additions. One quality, one price - the same standard on a single bathroom as on a ground-up build, with clear pricing agreed before the first demo day.

services.title: Remediation & Emergency
services.short_description: 24/7 water, mold, storm and fire response - then the rebuild, from the same licensed contractor.
services.long_description: The storm passed, the pipe burst, the smoke cleared. Wolfpack responds across Orlando and Central Florida with emergency board-up, water extraction, drying, mold remediation and fire and smoke restoration - then rebuilds. One licensed general contractor, one point of contact, no hand-off to a third party when the hard part starts.

testimonials.name: Jennifer J.
testimonials.text: The level of service was top notch and we were treated like family. Words cannot express how blessed we were during such an incredibly stressful time. I highly recommend Wolfpack for any of your residential construction projects!

testimonials.name: Kristine S.
testimonials.text: Strong communication and a willingness to explain things to me in layman terms. Would recommend and use again.
